title: Avoiding patterns with three distinct letters in Canon permutations
summary: We study avoidance of patterns of length $3$ with three distinct letters in canon permutations. We reduce the problem to studying pattern avoidance in lattice words and show that there are $6$ such pattern avoiding classes. This shows that there are $12$ classes for the original Canon permutation pattern avoidance problem. We also give descent refinements for these classes and classify the patterns for which the descent enumeration gives palindromic and $γ$-positive polynomials.
